definition: VIZ describes Claymores as a new breed of warrior and humanity's defense against Yoma: half-human, half-monster, silver-eyed slayers with supernatural strength who struggle against savage impulses and losing their humanity.
cultural_caution: Claymore is a fictional group/role and hybrid condition, not an individual endpoint. Its fictional hybridization and transformation language must not be applied to real people or read as a statement about any gender, ancestry, disability, or humanity.

supports: VIZ's description of Claymores as half-human/half-monster defenders with supernatural strength and a loss-of-humanity risk.

work_or_witness: Claymore series page · Series heading and description
definition: VIZ's series description presents the Claymores as sword-wielding women warriors and humanity's defense against supernatural destructive beings.
